hook.name: QSimpleLaunch
hook.description: A factory and hook for one-transaction token launches on Uniswap v4: deploys a fixed-supply token, opens a pool, and permanently locks the entire position in the hook. Per-launch style presets optionally apply anti-snipe charges, wallet caps, cooldowns, trading taxes, buybacks, and referral splits via per-pool launch-block contracts. Pools track a bonding milestone at 80% supply sold.
